views._section: Vue form du poste : ajout des sections Drugcam
views.name: customer.asset.workstation.form.eurekam_traca
views.arch:
<xpath expr="//sheet/group" position="after">
    <group string="Configuration matérielle Drugcam">
        <group string="Identification">
            <field name="x_workstation_type"/>
            <field name="x_workstation_serial_number"/>
            <field name="x_installation_date"/>
        </group>
        <group string="UC">
            <field name="x_uc_model"/>
            <field name="x_pc_serial_number"/>
            <field name="x_cpu_version"/>
        </group>
    </group>
    <group>
        <group string="Bloc optique">
            <field name="x_optical_block_type"/>
            <field name="x_optical_block_serial"/>
        </group>
        <group string="Caméra de scène">
            <field name="x_scene_camera_model"/>
            <field name="x_scene_camera_serial"/>
        </group>
    </group>
    <group>
        <group string="Caméra A (plus petit S/N)">
            <field name="x_camera_a_model"/>
            <field name="x_camera_a_serial"/>
            <field name="x_camera_a_objective"/>
            <field name="x_camera_a_cable"/>
        </group>
        <group string="Caméra B (plus grand S/N)">
            <field name="x_camera_b_model"/>
            <field name="x_camera_b_serial"/>
            <field name="x_camera_b_objective"/>
            <field name="x_camera_b_cable"/>
        </group>
    </group>
    <group string="Accessoires">
        <group>
            <field name="x_mouse_model"/>
            <field name="x_power_supply_type"/>
        </group>
        <group>
            <field name="x_inox_plot_type"/>
        </group>
    </group>
    <group string="Commentaires">
        <field name="x_comments" nolabel="1" placeholder="Notes libres sur l'installation de ce poste…"/>
    </group>
</xpath>
